rv.q: Pulitzer Prize winner burns bright enough to scorch but also to illuminate.
Miller turns in a faultless performance.
Sienna Miller as Maggie provides exactly that in the first half, bursting into the bedroom she shares with her husband, Brick.
I've never seen one that goes at it with such kit-off abandon.

Sienna Miller - who made her West End debut in David Lan's production of As It back in 2005 - conveys something of Maggie's desperation but it's a strained performance and there are times when her accent makes it sound like she's been binge-watching Justified.
Colm Meaney, though a gifted performer, is in no way a Mississippi plantation owner.
